pickup_instructions: Departs from the MTCC public ferry terminal in Malé (route 309, via Gulhi and Guraidhoo). Tickets are cash-only, bought at the terminal counter before departure; no online booking.
dropoff_instructions: Arrives at the public jetty on Maafushi island.
booking_requirements: No advance booking; arrive at least 15 minutes before the scheduled departure. Does not run on Fridays.
description: The government-run MTCC public ferry linking Malé to the popular local-tourism island of Maafushi, Kaafu Atoll, on route 309.
notes: Fare and ~90-minute duration confirmed via multiple independent sources in a search for 'MTCC ferry Male Maafushi fare 2026' (holiday.com.mv, thingstodoplace.com, budgetmaldives.com, maldivesnomad.com all converge on MVR 22 / ~USD 1.50, ~90 min). Distance (27 km) sourced from holiday.com.mv's Maafushi transfer page, cited via a separate search for Active Watersports/iCom speedboat pricing on the same route. Operator recorded as MTCC (Maldives Transport and Contracting Company), the government ferry authority that runs route 309 and the Malé ferry terminal; a June-2026 note in one source flags the Malé terminal was temporarily relocated opposite the Maldives Police Service building at that time, which may or may not still apply.

pickup_instructions: Departs from the public jetty on Maafushi island.
dropoff_instructions: Arrives at the MTCC public ferry terminal in Malé.
booking_requirements: No advance booking; cash-only ticket bought at the jetty. Does not run on Fridays.
description: The return leg of the government-run MTCC public ferry between Maafushi (Kaafu Atoll) and Malé, route 309.
notes: Recorded as a separate directional entry per the task rule, not assumed symmetric with the Malé→Maafushi entry — evidence for this direction is the same route-309 fare structure and schedule reporting a Guraidhoo-side return departure (the same run continues on to/from Maafushi); sources (thingstodoplace.com, budgetmaldives.com, holiday.com.mv) describe the MVR 22 fare as the flat route fare rather than a one-way-only figure, so it is used for both directions of this route. Duration and distance mirrored from the outbound entry since sources describe route 309 as a single fixed run in both directions.

pickup_instructions: Departs from the MTCC public ferry terminal in Malé, route 309 (via Gulhi, continuing to Guraidhoo).
dropoff_instructions: Arrives at the public jetty on Guraidhoo island, Kaafu Atoll (distinct from the same-named island in Thaa Atoll).
booking_requirements: No advance booking; cash-only ticket at the terminal. Does not run on Fridays.
description: The MTCC public ferry (route 309) from Malé to Guraidhoo, Kaafu Atoll — a 2 hour 15 minute run.
notes: Confirmed via a search for 'MTCC public ferry Male Guraidhoo Kaafu fare price schedule': fare MVR 22 per person, journey time 2h15m, route 309, cross-referenced against Wikipedia's 'Guraidhoo (Kaafu Atoll)' page and moovitapp.com's route-309 listing ('K. Guraidho – Male City'). A private speedboat alternative ('The Escape', ~USD 25, 45 min) also surfaced in the same search but its operator could not be independently confirmed, so it was not added as its own entry.

pickup_instructions: Departs from the public jetty on Guraidhoo island, Kaafu Atoll, Saturday–Thursday at approximately 07:00.
dropoff_instructions: Arrives at the MTCC public ferry terminal in Malé.
booking_requirements: No advance booking; cash-only ticket. Does not run on Fridays.
description: The return leg of the MTCC route-309 public ferry, Guraidhoo to Malé.
notes: Recorded as an independent directional entry: the same search that confirmed the outbound route also reported a distinct Guraidhoo-side departure time ('departs from Guraidhoo Saturday to Thursday at 7am'), i.e. real evidence of this direction's own scheduled service, not an assumption of symmetry. Fare (MVR 22) taken from the same route-309 sourcing as the outbound entry, since sources describe it as the route's flat fare rather than a one-way-only figure.

pickup_instructions: Departs from the MTCC public ferry terminal in Malé, route 308, daily except Friday at 14:30.
dropoff_instructions: Arrives at the public jetty on Himmafushi island, Kaafu Atoll, at approximately 15:10.
booking_requirements: No advance booking; cash-only ticket at the terminal. Does not run on Fridays.
description: The MTCC public ferry (route 308, which also continues to Huraa, Thulusdhoo and Dhiffushi) from Malé to Himmafushi, Kaafu Atoll.
notes: Price is a lower-confidence, hedged figure: budgetmaldives.com's 'Malé to Himmafushi' guide states 'around US$2 per person one-way', which is somewhat below the MVR 22 (~USD 1.50) flat fare cited elsewhere for other Kaafu Atoll routes (Maafushi/Guraidhoo) on the same MTCC network — both figures are in the same ballpark but not identical, so this is flagged as approximate rather than exact. Duration (40 min) is well corroborated: budgetmaldives.com's own figure matches the 14:30→15:10 schedule times found via a separate search. The reverse (Himmafushi→Malé) direction was not added as its own entry despite a confirmed 08:00 departure time, to avoid padding the dataset with a near-duplicate of this entry at the same hedged fare.

luggage_allowance: Up to 3 pieces of luggage free per passenger; an extra ticket must be purchased for each additional piece.
pickup_instructions: Ferry jetty adjacent to the arrivals area at Velana International Airport, on Hulhulé island.
dropoff_instructions: Arrives at the Malé ferry terminal, a short walk from the city centre.
booking_requirements: No booking; buy a ticket at the jetty booth in cash (MVR or USD generally accepted) and board the next departure.
description: The short public ferry shuttle connecting Velana International Airport (on the uninhabited island of Hulhulé, administratively part of Malé City) directly to Malé island.
notes: Confirmed via thaiest.com, lifeofdoing.com, maldivesairport.com and maleairport.com: MVR 15 per trip for the standard 10-minute crossing, with one source (via a moovitapp/'airport ferry' search) noting a higher MVR 20 fare 'first thing in the morning' — this early-morning surcharge was not used as the recorded price since it is a variant, not the standard fare. Runs 24 hours, every 10–15 minutes by day and every ~30 minutes overnight. Operator recorded as MTCC based on a search confirming MTCC as the current sole public-ferry operator out of Malé; moderate confidence only, since this specific airport route (distinct from the separate Malé–Hulhumalé route) was not independently re-confirmed as MTCC-run by a second source, and it was historically associated with a joint MACL/MPL/MTCC arrangement. Origin recorded as 'Velana International Airport' per the task's one allowed new location, on Hulhulé island (excluded from the 193-island dataset as uninhabited); atoll code MLE used since Hulhulé is administratively part of Malé City per data/maldives/locations/atolls.json's own notes. Distance (2 km) and duration (10 min) both from thaiest.com's ferry-route description.

pickup_instructions: Bus terminus in Malé; the route crosses the Sinamalé Bridge via Hulhulé (the airport island).
booking_requirements: Fare paid via a rechargeable bus card, purchasable at the ferry terminal/bus terminus in Malé or Hulhumalé; cash is not accepted on board per the sourced report.
description: The public bus service across the Sinamalé Bridge connecting Malé, the airport island of Hulhulé, and the reclaimed suburb of Hulhumalé — the land-based alternative to the ferry.
notes: Fare confirmed via edition.mv ('MPL announces bus fares for Sinamale Bridge routes'), see.mv ('MPL sets bus fares at MVR 10') and corporatemaldives.com ('10 rufiyaa fare for Male-Hulhumale bus'): MVR 10 one-way, effective from 1 January 2019 (the service was free immediately after the bridge's September 2018 opening). Flagged as lower-confidence on currency of the figure: no 2025/2026-dated source re-confirmed this exact fare is still in force, only the original ~2019 announcement, so it may have since changed. Operator recorded as Maldives Ports Limited (MPL), which the sourced reporting credits with setting and operating this specific bus fare (distinct from MTCC, which a related search found now operates the separate Malé–Hulhumalé passenger ferry). Duration not found in snippets reviewed; left null.

pickup_instructions: Kurumba resort representative meets guests in the arrivals hall at Velana International Airport.
dropoff_instructions: Kurumba Maldives jetty, Vihamanaafushi island, Kaafu Atoll — one of the shortest resort transfers in the Maldives.
booking_requirements: Arranged through Kurumba Maldives' own resort-information/transfer booking channel.
description: Kurumba Maldives' own shared speedboat transfer from Velana International Airport, a roughly 5-minute crossing to the country's first resort island.
notes: Price sourced from a search summarizing kurumba.com's own resort-information/'preparing to visit' pages: USD 49.50++ per adult, one-way (USD 24.75++ for children), where '++' denotes the resort's stated exclusion of a 10% service charge and 16% GST. A separate aggregator, maldivestour.guide, independently lists 'from $50' for the same transfer, corroborating the figure. A private-speedboat alternative (USD 75++ per adult) is also offered by Kurumba but was not added as a separate entry in this pass. Operator recorded as 'Universal Resorts', the exact existing accommodation-operator name for Kurumba Maldives already in this dataset, since this is the resort's own transfer product. Distance not stated in snippets; left null.

pickup_instructions: Baros representative meets guests at Velana International Airport; transfer timing is arranged around guests' international flight times.
dropoff_instructions: Baros Maldives jetty, Baros island, Kaafu Atoll.
booking_requirements: Coordinated with the resort in advance around guest flight details; complimentary return transfer is offered for certain half-board bookings of 3+ nights per the source.
description: Baros Maldives' own shared, resort-scheduled speedboat transfer from Velana International Airport, a 25-minute crossing.
notes: Round-trip, per-person, tax-inclusive price of USD 260 confirmed via a search citing baros.com/its official FAQ (a related children's rate of USD 130 for ages 8-11 was also given, not recorded here as this dataset covers the adult fare). A closely-matching but slightly different figure (~USD 250–259 round trip) surfaced in an earlier, separate search of secondary sources (antisocialtourist.com, general Maldives-transfer guides); USD 260 was used as the figure most directly attributed to baros.com/its FAQ. A distinct 'private transfer' option exists but is listed as 'rates on request' with no figure, so it was not recorded as its own entry per the task's NOT-NULL price rule. 'shared_or_private' recorded as shared since the source explicitly describes this as 'shared transfers... arranged according to guest international flights'. Operator recorded as 'Baros Maldives' (the resort's own operating brand) since no distinct accommodation-operator name is yet on record for Baros in this dataset (confirmed via accommodations.json, where Baros Maldives' operator_name is currently null).

pickup_instructions: Velassaru resort representative meets guests at Velana International Airport; guests must send flight details at least 72 hours ahead to guarantee the transfer.
dropoff_instructions: Velassaru Maldives jetty, Velassaru island, Kaafu Atoll.
booking_requirements: Mandatory resort-operated transfer — third-party transfer arrangement is not permitted per the source; flight details required at least 72 hours before arrival.
description: Velassaru Maldives' own mandatory speedboat transfer from Velana International Airport, a 25-minute crossing.
notes: LOWER CONFIDENCE ENTRY. Price (USD 187 per person) was found via aggregator sites (maldivestour.guide, callainamaldives.com) in the initial search, but a follow-up search specifically targeting velassaru.com/its FAQ could not independently re-confirm this exact figure from the resort's own site in the snippets returned — only the mandatory, resort-only nature of the transfer was corroborated directly. Whether USD 187 is a one-way or round-trip figure is also explicitly ambiguous in the source material (the AI summary itself hedged 'this appears to be the round trip rate'); it is recorded here as the per-person price as stated, without assuming round-trip. 'shared_or_private' recorded as 'private' on the reasoning that the transfer is resort-exclusive/mandatory and no shared/scheduled alternative is mentioned, though the source does not use the word 'private' explicitly — treat this field as a reasonable inference rather than a directly-quoted label. Operator recorded as 'Universal Resorts', the exact existing accommodation-operator name for Velassaru Maldives already in this dataset.

pickup_instructions: Gili Lankanfushi representative meets guests at Velana International Airport.
dropoff_instructions: Gili Lankanfushi jetty, Lankanfushi island, Kaafu Atoll (North Malé Atoll).
booking_requirements: Arranged through the resort's own transfer booking channel.
description: Gili Lankanfushi's own shared return speedboat transfer from Velana International Airport, roughly a 20 km, 30-minute crossing.
notes: Price sourced via maldivestour.guide ('Gili Lankanfushi Speedboat Transfer | Male Airport – $75' in the search-result title referred to a different, unconfirmed lower figure not used here) and a more specific figure surfaced directly in the search summary: 'shared return speedboat transfers from the airport are US$302 per person (excluding taxes and service charge)... USD 302.44 per person for a roundtrip.' A second, looser figure ('approximately USD 240–300 per adult... as of 2025') also appeared and is noted here as a corroborating range rather than used as the primary figure. Distance (~20 km) and duration (30 min, alternatively cited as 25 min by traveljee.com) both from traveljee.com's 'How to Get to Gili Lankanfushi' guide. Operator recorded as 'Gili Lankanfushi' (the resort's own operating brand) since no distinct accommodation-operator name is yet on record for Gili Lankanfushi in this dataset (confirmed via accommodations.json, where its operator_name is currently null).

pickup_instructions: Kaani Hotels representative meets guests at Velana International Airport arrivals.
dropoff_instructions: Kaani Beach Hotel jetty, Maafushi island, Kaafu Atoll.
booking_requirements: Booked directly through Kaani Beach Hotel/Kaani Hotels as part of a stay.
description: Kaani Hotels' own shared speedboat transfer from Velana International Airport to its Maafushi property, a 35-minute crossing.
notes: Confirmed via a Tripadvisor forum thread ('Kaani speedboat to Maafushi USD$20/person') independently corroborated by makemytrip.global's Kaani Beach Hotel listing summary: USD 20 per person one-way, 35 minutes. The same summary also notes a private full-boat charter option at USD 150 (max 8 guests) — recorded here only in the `capacity` field of this shared entry as context, not as its own private-transfer line item, since the $20 figure is specifically the shared per-person rate. Operator recorded as 'Kaani Hotels', the exact existing provider name already in this dataset for Kaani Beach Hotel, Maafushi.

pickup_instructions: iCom Tours representative meets guests at Velana International Airport.
dropoff_instructions: Public jetty area, Maafushi island, Kaafu Atoll.
booking_requirements: Bookable directly with iCom Tours (icomtours.com) ahead of arrival.
description: A shared, scheduled speedboat transfer from Velana International Airport to Maafushi, run by the independent operator iCom Tours (distinct from the government MTCC public ferry and from resort-specific operators like Kaani Hotels).
notes: Confirmed real, independently-operated service via maafushidive.com's own 'Transport' page (which recommends booking scheduled speedboat tickets 'through ICOMtours or MaafushiTours') citing about USD 25 per person, 45 minutes. A separate, more direct search on iCom Tours itself found a Tripadvisor FAQ/review thread giving a higher, more recent figure (USD 30 per person, 'prices checked May–June 2026', vs. an older USD 20 figure); USD 25 was used as the figure most consistently repeated across sources and as a mid-point that appears in the operator's own referenced pricing rather than the single higher outlier. Flagged as an approximate/likely-to-drift fare given the explicit note that prices have risen over time. Operator recorded as 'iCom Tours', the exact existing provider name already in this dataset.

pickup_instructions: Soneva's own seaplane lounge/terminal area at Velana International Airport.
dropoff_instructions: Soneva Fushi's own seaplane jetty, Kunfunadhoo island, Baa Atoll.
booking_requirements: Arranged through Soneva Fushi's own reservations/transfer booking process ahead of arrival, coordinated with international flight times.
description: Soneva Fushi's own published shared round-trip seaplane transfer from Velana International Airport to Kunfunadhoo island, Baa Atoll.
notes: Price sourced directly from soneva.com's own 'Your Journey to Soneva Fushi' page via search: a round-trip shared seaplane fare of USD 950 per adult (USD 475 per child) for the 4 May–30 September 2026 season (the season current as of this research date, 19 September 2026); the same page states a higher USD 1,300 per adult (USD 650 per child) fare for the surrounding 1 Jan–3 May 2026 and 1 Oct 2026–3 May 2027 seasons — flagged here since the price is explicitly seasonal and will change again from 1 October 2026. Duration not stated in the snippet reviewed; left null. A private-charter option (USD 7,000–9,600 nett one-way, capacity-dependent) was also found but not recorded as its own entry since it is a full-aircraft charter rather than a discrete per-person service in the same sense as the other entries. The seaplane is described in sources as operated in practice by Manta Air (Soneva's primary current seaplane partner) and/or Trans Maldivian Airways, but since Soneva sells and prices this specific transfer product as its own resort service, the operator is recorded as 'Soneva Management (BVI) Limited', the exact existing accommodation-operator name for Soneva Fushi already in this dataset, matching the pattern already used for Soneva Fushi's dive-centre entries in data/maldives/diving/SOURCES.md.

service_name: Domestic Flight & Speedboat Transfer (Six Senses Laamu)
pickup_instructions: Domestic terminal at Velana International Airport for the ~40-minute flight to Kadhdhoo Airport, Laamu Atoll; a Six Senses Laamu representative meets guests at Kadhdhoo for the onward speedboat leg.
dropoff_instructions: Six Senses Laamu's own jetty, Olhuveli island, Laamu Atoll, after a roughly 15–20 minute speedboat ride from Kadhdhoo.
booking_requirements: Guests are strongly encouraged to coordinate international arrival/departure timing with this combined transfer; a chartered (private) boat leg can be arranged on request via the resort's Guest Experience Maker, subject to availability and added cost.
description: Six Senses Laamu's standard combined transfer: a domestic flight from Malé to Kadhdhoo Airport followed by a shared resort speedboat to Olhuveli island, Laamu Atoll.
notes: Round-trip price of USD 590 per person (subject to local government taxes and service charge) confirmed via a search summarizing Six Senses'/travel-press coverage of 'how to get to Six Senses Laamu'. A follow-up search confirmed the speedboat leg from Kadhdhoo is offered 'on a shared basis' by default, with private/chartered boat available only on request at extra cost — supporting `shared_or_private: shared` for this standard product. `transfer_type` recorded as `domestic_flight` since the Malé–Kadhdhoo flight is the defining, longer leg of this bundled product (this schema has no combined-transfer type); the speedboat leg is captured in `vehicle_type` and `dropoff_instructions` instead. `duration_minutes` (60) is an approximate sum of the sourced ~40-minute flight and ~15–20 minute speedboat legs, not a single directly-quoted total figure — flagged as an estimate. A separate, newer seaplane-transfer option was also found to have been added at Six Senses Laamu but no fixed USD figure for it surfaced in snippets reviewed, so it was not added as its own entry. Operator recorded as 'Six Senses', the exact existing accommodation-operator name for Six Senses Laamu already in this dataset, since Six Senses sells and prices this bundled transfer as its own product (the domestic flight itself is operated by a separate airline not clearly named in the snippets reviewed).
